_comment: Jodi voice agent - mid-call API tool (During conversation). Notation as in assess_risk.json. No real secrets in this file.
name: confirm_update
description: Saves the pending update (from record_update or onboarding_save) into the record. Call it ONLY after you have read readback_text and the caller has clearly said yes (haudu / sari / haan / ji haan / yes) to that exact read-back. Never call it after a 'no', a correction, silence or an unclear answer; in those cases fix the details and call record_update or onboarding_save again to get a new read-back. After it returns, read @confirm_say.
response_template: Saved: @update_saved. Say this to the caller: @confirm_say
if_it_fails: Sorry, I could not save this just now. I will try again after the call, and your ASHA will be told.
notes: 'confirmed' is a static true: the agent only calls this tool after a clear yes. A 'no' is handled by not calling it and re-running record_update / onboarding_save, which issues a new pending_id. This avoids LLM-filled body parameters, which the Sarvam docs do not document for API tools. Unconfirmed pending updates should expire on the backend.
pending_id is read from the agent variable written by the latest record_update / onboarding_save call, so it always points at the most recent read-back.
